dialogue.text: Pure brightness at time for outings, around April 5th is chiming pure brightness.
dialogue.zh: 清明是出遊的好時節，大約在四月五日左右。
dialogue.ja: 清明はお出かけにぴったりの時期で、だいたい4月5日頃です。
dialogue.local: Pure brightness at time for outings, around April 5th is chiming pure brightness.
dialogue.en: Pure brightness at time for outings, around April 5th is chiming pure brightness.

dialogue.text: The sky is clear and bright.
dialogue.ja: 空は澄んで明るいです。
dialogue.local: The sky is clear and bright.
dialogue.en: The sky is clear and bright.

dialogue.text: The air is fresh and clean.
dialogue.ja: 空気は新鮮で清らかです。
dialogue.local: The air is fresh and clean.
dialogue.en: The air is fresh and clean.

dialogue.text: Families visit their ancestors' graves to clean and pay respects.
dialogue.ja: 家族は先祖の墓を訪れて掃除し、敬意を表します。
dialogue.local: Families visit their ancestors' graves to clean and pay respects.
dialogue.en: Families visit their ancestors' graves to clean and pay respects.

dialogue.text: Their pool weeds place fresh flowers and bow.
dialogue.zh: 他們拔除雜草，插上鮮花並鞠躬。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは雑草を取り、新鮮な花を供え、頭を下げます。
dialogue.local: Their pool weeds place fresh flowers and bow.
dialogue.en: Their pool weeds place fresh flowers and bow.

dialogue.text: But chiming is also the perfect time for spring outings.
dialogue.zh: 但清明也是春遊的最佳時機。
dialogue.ja: しかし、清明は春の外出に最適な時期でもあります。
dialogue.local: But chiming is also the perfect time for spring outings.
dialogue.en: But chiming is also the perfect time for spring outings.

dialogue.text: Green grass, warm breeze, colorful kites flying in the sky.
dialogue.zh: 綠草如茵，微風和煦，五彩繽紛的風箏在天空飛翔。
dialogue.ja: 緑の草、暖かいそよ風、色とりどりの凧が空を飛んでいます。
dialogue.local: Green grass, warm breeze, colorful kites flying in the sky.
dialogue.en: Green grass, warm breeze, colorful kites flying in the sky.

dialogue.text: Willow trees sway gently. Children play in laugh.
dialogue.zh: 柳樹輕輕搖曳，孩子們歡笑著玩耍。
dialogue.ja: 柳の木が優しく揺れ、子どもたちは笑いながら遊んでいます。
dialogue.local: Willow trees sway gently. Children play in laugh.
dialogue.en: Willow trees sway gently. Children play in laugh.

dialogue.text: chiming means remembering the past and enjoying the present.
dialogue.zh: 清明意味著緬懷過去，享受當下。
dialogue.ja: 清明は過去を思い出し、今を楽しむことを意味します。
dialogue.local: chiming means remembering the past and enjoying the present.
dialogue.en: chiming means remembering the past and enjoying the present.
